storyCards.headline: Carrie Anne: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Hollies's "Carrie Anne" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

Carrie Anne was released in 1967.
